_about: Reviewed mapping (canonical make, DEGEM normalized) -> catalogue kinuy_mishari values for the recall notices (src/gov_data/recalls.py). The build only ADDS entries whose DEGEM equals a catalogue kinuy_mishari of that make after normalization (origin exact_normalized_equality); the pull request is the review. A reviewer may add entries by hand (origin reviewer) or delete a wrong one. `unresolved` lists every (make, DEGEM) the build could not map, largest first: no recall is served for a model until its entry is here.
